Workflows.chain_desc_1: A robust 3-step cascading workflow that transforms monolithic code architectures into secure, modular microservices with thorough security auditing.

Leaderboard.title: AI Impact Leaderboard & Hall of Fame
Leaderboard.subtitle: Moving beyond superficial likes: Ranked strictly by real engineering utility, Fork Counts, Used frequency in workflows, and Community Trust!
Leaderboard.how_it_works: How is the ranking calculated? (Gamification Metrics)
Leaderboard.how_it_works_desc: Impact Score = (Forks × 10) + (Used in Projects × 3) + (Likes × 2). In our ecosystem, resources that genuinely accelerate real codebases earn higher impact rankings and prestigious badges like 'Grand Vibe Master'!

CLI.title: Autonomous Agent Terminal & IDE Integrations
CLI.subtitle: Our biggest competitive moat: Sync decentralized AI context, architectural standards, and verified prompts directly into your command line, Cursor, VS Code, and Claude Desktop via the Model Context Protocol (MCP)!
CLI.config_subtitle: Select your preferred tool below and copy the quick setup commands directly into your workspace.
CLI.card_cli_desc: With a single 'devcommons pull' command, import rules or prompt cascades straight into your project repository without leaving your terminal.
CLI.card_ide_desc: Open the Command Palette (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+P) and type 'DevCommons: Search' to bring instant architectural context directly into your active workspace.
CLI.card_mcp_desc: Connect Anthropic Claude Code or Claude Desktop to DevCommons securely with our open Model Context Protocol (MCP) server endpoint!
